passage.text: Nam is sick, so she goes to see a nurse at her university.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm ɪz ˈsɪk, soʊ ʃiː ˈɡoʊz tə ˈsiː ə ˈnɜːrs ət hɜːr ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti.

passage.text: "Good morning. What are your symptoms?" the nurse says.
passage.reading: ˈɡʊd ˈmɔːrnɪŋ. ˈwʌt ər jʊr ˈsɪmptəmz? ðə ˈnɜːrs ˈsɛz.

passage.text: "I have a runny nose, and I sneeze all day," Nam says.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈhæv ə ˈrʌni ˈnoʊz, ənd aɪ ˈsniːz ˈɔːl ˈdeɪ, ˈnɑːm ˈsɛz.

passage.text: "My throat hurts, too, but I don't have a fever."
passage.reading: maɪ ˈθroʊt ˈhɜːrts, ˈtuː, bʌt aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈhæv ə ˈfiːvər.

passage.text: "I think you have a cold," the nurse says.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈθɪŋk juː ˈhæv ə ˈkoʊld, ðə ˈnɜːrs ˈsɛz.

passage.text: "You should rest and drink a lot of water."
passage.reading: juː ʃʊd ˈrɛst ənd ˈdrɪŋk ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈwɔːtər.

passage.text: "Here's some medicine for your runny nose."
passage.reading: hɪrz sʌm ˈmɛdəsən fər jʊr ˈrʌni ˈnoʊz.

passage.text: "Thank you! I feel better already," Nam says.
passage.reading: ˈθæŋk juː! aɪ ˈfiːl ˈbɛtər ɔːlˈrɛdi, ˈnɑːm ˈsɛz.
